newsitem.title: GERMANY: German call money rates up at around 3.15 percent.
newsitem.headline: German call money rates up at around 3.15 percent.

text.p: German call money rates edged up as high as 3.30 percent on Tuesday with the bulk of trades taking place around 3.15 percent, dealers said.
Banks were scrambling to meet monthly reserve requirements ahead of the end-of-month deadline over the long Easter weekend, dealers said.

Deposits with the central bank rose to 42 billion marks on Monday from 40.8 billion, the monthly average was little changed at 40.9 billion marks and Lombard borrowings were 500 million marks. The Frankfurt Interbank Overnight Average FIONA= was at 3.21000 percent (versus 3.14433 pct).
